title: Senior IT Solutions Consultant
description:
**Your IT Future, Delivered**
=============================

**Senior IT Solutions Consultant**
==================================

With a global team of 5600 IT professionals, DHL IT Services enables DHL to **connect people** and keep the global economy running **by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions**. We work globally **beyond borders** and push boundaries across **all dimensions of logistics**. You can **leave your mark** shaping the **technological backbone** of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices in Germany, Malaysia, Czech Republic and India have earned **#GreatPlaceToWork** certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**

At IT Services, we are passionate about technology. Our Clearance team is looking for a Senior IT Solutions Consultant who can translate business needs into practical technology solutions, work closely with global stakeholders, and identify opportunities to improve products, processes, testing, and operational efficiency.

*#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace**#Cloud #AsOne #DevOps*

**Grow together**

As a **Senior IT Solutions Consultant**, you will:

* Analyse business, functional, technical, user, and process requirements and translate them into effective solution recommendations.
* Work with business and technology stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve dependencies, and support solution design and implementation.
* Review product roadmaps, backlogs, and upcoming feature releases, highlighting open questions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations.
* Identify product and process improvement opportunities aligned with business priorities.
* Provide specialist advice across areas such as test automation, security, data privacy, change readiness, and service improvement.
* Support delivery teams with requirement definition, solution options, impact analysis, complexity assessment, and implementation readiness.
* Identify and resolve design conflicts and coordinate technical resources across teams where required.
* Support change implementation, stakeholder engagement, knowledge transfer, and transition into business-as-usual operations.
* Prepare and deliver clear presentations, recommendations, business cases, and decision-support materials.
* Promote knowledge sharing and provide guidance to colleagues within the consultant’s specialist area.

**Automation, testing, and AI-driven improvements** **(Good to have)**

The consultant will also be expected to

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive testing and operational activities.
* Support the automation of test cases and regression-testing scenarios.
* Design or implement AI-assisted test-data-generation use cases with appropriate controls and validation.
* Explore AI opportunities across testing, documentation, support operations, knowledge management, and root-cause analysis.
* Define measurable productivity or quality improvements for AI and automation use cases.
* Identify opportunities to scale successful AI or automation use cases across products, teams, or domains.
* Ensure AI-generated outputs and automated test results are appropriately reviewed and validated before implementation.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**

? Strong experience in consulting, business analysis, requirements management, or technology solution delivery.

? Ability to analyse complex business and technical requirements and recommend practical solution options.

? Strong understanding of business processes, system integration, solution design, testing, change management, and implementation.

? Experience working with global, cross-functional, and remote teams.

? Ability to communicate effectively with business colleagues, technical teams, architects, project managers, and senior stakeholders.

? Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and presentation skills.

? A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently, identify opportunities, and drive recommendations.

? Knowledge of current IT trends and evolving technologies.

? Exposure to test automation, generative AI, agentic AI, or AI-assisted engineering practices would be an advantage

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications

title: Oracle HCM Cloud Support Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

We require a mid-level Oracle HCM Cloud consultant to join our expanding Managed Services team. The consultant must have experience of at least one HCM Cloud project as a functional expert, having previously worked with the Core HR, Absence and HR Helpdesk modules. Experience of other Oracle HCM products (in particular, E-Business Suite) would be advantageous.

You will come up with design solutions, offer expertise and provide guidance to our clients on best practices for the successful delivery of the chosen solution as part of an ongoing Managed Service. You should be customer focussed with strong documentation skills and able to work independently and unsupervised.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide day to day application support for a variety of clients.
* Provide training and coaching for other colleagues
* Assist in pre-sales activities via demos
* Offer expert advice regarding Cloud processes, configuration options and roadmaps
* Provide functional leadership and guidance to clients regarding "leading practices" and the functionality of the software modules through as part of an ongoing Managed Service
* Ability to effectively work with end-users remotely
* Positive, dynamic, and flexible attitude, should be an excellent team player

  
**Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications:**

* In depth knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud including Core HR module
* Minimum 4-5 years' experience of Oracle HCM Cloud
* Strong experience translating business requirements and design into functional solutions
* Excellent spoken and written English language communication skills
* Document solutions clearly and share knowledge freely with our Cloud community
* Demonstrate self-initiative and ability to work independently and unsupervised
* Display a passion for the role and a strong desire to deliver to the best of your ability

**Desirable Skills:**

* Knowledge of other HCM Cloud modules (HR Helpdesk, Talent, Absence, ORC, OTL)
* E-Business Suite HRMS knowledge
* ITIL process knowledge
* Wider experience of HR processes from a business context
* Oracle HCM Cloud certifications would be an advantage.

  
**Additional Information**

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Lead Consultant
description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

**Your Impact:** OpenText is a world leader in Information Management, helping companies securely capture, govern and exchange information on a global scale. OpenText solves digital business challenges for Clients, ranging from small and mid\-sized businesses to the largest and most complex organizations in the world. That is high tech without the drama.
  
Responsible for working with customer to understand their infrastructure provisioning, patching and compliance requirements and automate the same with OpenText Hybrid cloud suite. Candidate must possess a strong knowledge on OpenText ITOM products – Micro Focus Hybrid Cloud Management (HCMx), Micro Focus Operations Orchestration (OO), Micro Focus Server Automation (SA), Micro Focus Data Center Automation (DCA) and Micro Focus Network Automation (NA).
  
  

**What the role offers:**  

* Designing end\-to\-end solutions on ITOM Platforms (HCMx, OO, SA, DCA and NA).
* Experience with requirement elicitation and translating the requirements into low\-level and high\-level design documents.
* Creating and demonstrating prototypes.
* Liaise with the local, regional teams and customer representatives in delivering the solutions.
* Help project managers with the effort estimations and guide the team members with technical solutions.
* Act as a primary escalation point and work with the support, R and customer teams in resolving the issue.
* Participate in internal initiatives and create new solution offerings for generating additional business.
* Participate in pre\-sales discussions and work towards the successful delivery of the deal.


**What you need to succeed:**  

* Hands\-on experience with installing upgrade, configuration, and administration of OpenText ITOM products (HCMx, OO, SA, DCA and NA)
* Hands on experience in Hybrid Cloud Management (CSA/HCM) – with implementing complex service designs, service offerings, cost governance, cloud aggregations, complex OO flows to meet specific business requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with developing OO flow using OO operations for API calls, DB Queries, JSON/XML/YAML, remote operations and integrating with other ITOM products either in studio or web\-designer.
* Hands on experience in Server Automation (SA) – with implementing server provisioning, patch management, compliance management, software deployment and OPTIC reporting.
* Hands on experience in Network Automation (NA) – which involves managing network devices by integrating with NNMi, ensuring network device compliance, performing network device configuration backups\& upgrades, OPTIC reporting, and developing new device drivers. Good knowledge in networking, network devices, network protocols etc.
* Hands\-on experience in any one of scripting \- Python, JavaScript, Shell scripting, PowerShell scripting etc.


**One last thing:**  

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.
  
  

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Presales Executive
description:
Garudalytics is Looking for Presales executives. We are looking for an energetic, technically proficient, and client\-facing Pre\-Sales / Techno\-Sales Specialist who can understand customer requirements, translate them into appropriate geospatial technology solutions, and effectively demonstrate the value of Garudalytics' products and capabilities.

The role will involve a combination of technical pre\-sales, solution consulting, product demonstrations, PoCs, RFP/RFI/tender support, technical proposal preparation, and customer engagement.

The ideal candidate should have practical exposure to Open\-Source Geospatial technologies and GIS implementation projects, along with strong communication and presentation skills.

Key Responsibilities :

1\. Product Demonstrations \& Technical Presentations

* Conduct professional product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and solution walkthroughs for prospective clients.
* Demonstrate Garudalytics platforms including GSM, G\-Map, G\-Field, and other relevant Geospatial\-AI solutions.
* Develop demonstration workflows and use cases based on specific customer requirements.
* Support technical Proof of Concept (PoC) activities and solution validations.

2\. Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting

* Understand customer business, operational, and geospatial requirements through meetings, discussions, and requirement\-gathering sessions.
* Translate business requirements into appropriate GIS, WebGIS, spatial analytics, field\-data, and GeoAI solutions.
* Prepare solution concepts, technical approaches, architecture diagrams, workflows, presentations, and technical documentation.
* Work with internal technical teams to develop customized solutions and implementation approaches.

3\. RFP / RFI / RFQ / Tender Support

* Analyze RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, EoIs, tenders, and technical requirements.
* Prepare technical proposals, compliance matrices, solution documents, technical write\-ups, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with sales, technical, and delivery teams to ensure accurate and timely bid submissions.
* Support responses relating to Make\-in\-India, Class\-I/Local Supplier, indigenous technology, and technical compliance requirements.

4\. Client Engagement \& Technical Discussions

* Participate in meetings with government departments, PSUs, defence organizations, infrastructure organizations, and enterprise customers.
* Present technical capabilities and solution value to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Respond to technical and techno\-commercial queries during the sales cycle.
* Conduct requirement discussions, technical workshops, and solution discovery sessions.

5\. Technical Value Selling

* Clearly communicate the business value and differentiators of geospatial technologies and Garudalytics' proprietary platforms.
* Convert complex technical concepts into business\-oriented outcomes and use cases.
* Identify opportunities for GIS modernization, enterprise mapping, spatial analytics, field applications, GeoAI, and digital transformation.

6\. Sales–Technology–Delivery Coordination

* Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, Engineering, and Project Delivery teams.
* Capture customer feedback, requirements, and product enhancement requests.
* Coordinate with technical teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with customer expectations.
* Support the sales team throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from initial engagement through technical closure.

Required Qualifications

Educational Qualification

Bachelor's degree in any relevant technical discipline, preferably:

* Remote Sensing / Geoinformatics / Geospatial Technology
* B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering
* B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical Engineering
* Computer Science / Information Technology
* GIS / Geography / Geomatics
* Or another relevant technical discipline

Professional Experience

* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in Geospatial/GIS project implementation, technical consulting, pre\-sales, or techno\-sales.
* Practical exposure to Open\-Source Geospatial technologies and GIS project execution/implementation.
* Candidates with experience in both GIS implementation and customer\-facing technical roles will be preferred.
* Experience supporting government/PSU tenders, RFPs, or Geospatial projects will be an added advantage.

Technical Skills

Candidates should have working knowledge of several of the following:

* QGIS
* PostGIS / Spatial Databases
* GeoServer
* GDAL / OGR
* OpenLayers / Leaflet
* MapServer
* WebGIS and Enterprise GIS architectures
* Spatial data processing and visualization
* Vector and raster data
* Remote Sensing and satellite imagery
* GIS data management and spatial analysis
* Field Data Collection and Mobile GIS workflows
* API\-based GIS integration
* GeoAI / AI\-ML applications in geospatial domains

Knowledge of Python, SQL, REST APIs, cloud technologies, or GIS application development will be an added advantage.

Tender \& Government\-Sector Exposure

Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred:

* Government / PSU Geospatial and GIS projects
* RFP / RFI / RFQ / EoI analysis
* Technical compliance and bid documentation
* Preparation of technical proposals and solution documents
* Make\-in\-India / Local Content / Class\-I or Class\-II procurement requirements
* Pre\-bid queries and technical clarifications
* Technical presentations to government and enterprise stakeholders

Key Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong presentation and product demonstration abilities
* Ability to engage confidently with customers and senior stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to understand and document customer requirements
* Good technical documentation and proposal\-writing skills
* Client\-centric and consultative approach
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross\-functional teams
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings, demonstrations, workshops, PoCs, and project engagements

Interested and serious candidates can share their resumes to hr@garudalytics.com

Pay: ₹450,000\.00 \- ₹650,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Advisory Solution Consultant
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

As a member of our Solution Consulting team, you will have a major impact on our future success by supporting \[Employee Experience, Customer Workflow, ITX] Solution Sales. You will guide revenue for one of our products with the support and partnership of Sales, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a hands\-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles.

**What you get to do in this role:**


The Solution Consultant is a technical consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position and provide product\-specific solutions during sales cycles while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

* Support product sales as a technical and domain expert of a client\-facing sales team
* Lead discovery workshops to determine customers' challenges and give product demonstrations to align our solution with customer needs
* Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, channel partners and ServiceNow colleagues
* Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value
* Share and learn best practices and re\-usable assets with other Solution Consultants to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
* Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
* Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10\+ years of pre\-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or technical expertise with cloud software solutions
* Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services
* Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterpart to guide execution excellence
* Travel, as necessary

  

FD21

title: KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER
description:
Job Description:
* **Role Overview**
The **Key Account Manager (KAM)** is a senior technical sales leadership role responsible for managing and growing relationships with nominated **Global Strategic Accounts** across India. This position requires deep expertise in the **Data Centre, Hyperscale, and Colocation** segments, with the ability to influence key stakeholders—up to the **C‑Suite**—within customer organizations, as well as ecosystem partners such as consultants, specifiers, and contractors.
The KAM will drive Schneider Electric’s complete portfolio across business units, acting as the opportunity leader for complex, multi\-country pursuits and ensuring seamless collaboration between Secure Power and other divisions. This is a highly strategic role requiring business acumen, technical competency, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to execute global strategy at a country level.**Key Responsibilities****Customer \& Account Leadership**
	+ Serve as the **country owner for assigned global strategic accounts** and translate global strategy into local execution.
	+ Build strong **multi\-level customer relationships** including C‑level, influencers, and operational teams.
	+ Develop, manage, and execute **Strategic Account Plans** across the region.**Business Development \& Opportunity Management**
	+ Identify, shape, and drive opportunities for the **One Schneider Electric** portfolio, including Secure Power, Digital Energy, Industrial Automation, Power Systems, Power Products, and Services.
	+ Lead complex, large\-scale pursuits as the **opportunity leader**, mobilizing virtual teams across countries and divisions.
	+ Develop and grow Data Centre–related business (hyperscale and colocation) across electrical, cooling, software, automation, and services offerings.**Internal Collaboration \& Ecosystem Influence**
	+ Build strong working relationships with **Country Leadership, Divisions, and Regional Teams** to define and execute winning strategies.
	+ Engage with and influence the broader **ecosystem of consultants, specifiers, and contractors** involved in data centre construction and expansion.
	+ Ensure cross\-functional alignment across Sales, Pre\-Sales, Tendering, and Execution teams.**Operational Excellence**
	+ Deliver on **orders, revenue, margin**, and ensure forecast accuracy.
	+ Maintain strong compliance with **Customer Project Process (CPP)** and uphold CRM discipline and data quality.
	+ Conduct feasibility analysis of bids, tenders, and contracting documents for all key opportunities.**Commercial \& Technical Experience Requirements**
	+ Deep technical sales experience in **Data Centre Solutions** including power, cooling, electrical distribution, automation, and associated services.
	+ Proven capability to **manage and grow large strategic/global accounts**.
	+ Strong understanding of account management principles, sales channels, and partner ecosystems.
	+ Demonstrated capability to uncover and articulate customer pain points and propose **high‑value, integrated solutions**.
	+ Experience selling within a **matrix organization** and managing multi\-stakeholder environments.**Leadership Competencies**
	+ Ability to **lead virtual, cross\-functional, and remote teams** across geographies.
	+ Strong capability to navigate **complex matrix organizations** in a multicultural environment.
	+ High initiative, strong ownership mindset, and excellent organizational skills.
	+ Ability to influence and align diverse internal and external stakeholders.**Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**
	+ Strong executive presence with the ability to engage at **C‑Level**.
	+ Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
	+ Ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear, compelling **business language**.
High emotional intelligence, resilience, and collaborative mindset


(External) English Qualifications:
**Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in **engineering**; **MBA preferred**.
* **10–15\+ years** of experience in Key Account Management or similar roles within the Data Centre ecosystem.
* Experience working with **Hyperscalers, Global Cloud Providers, or Colocation Operators** preferred.

**Additional Requirements*** Willingness to travel (domestic/international as required).
